description_en: Displays all annotate members under the current tenant
description_zh: 展示当前租户下的全部标注成员
name: ListUsers

parameters.description_en: Tenant ID. For information about how to obtain a tenant ID, see [ListTenants](~~454649~~).
parameters.help_en: Tenant ID. For information about how to obtain a tenant ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454649.html
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.description_en: Page number of the annotate member list. The starting value is 1. The default value is 1.
parameters.description_zh: 标注成员列表的页码。起始值为1，默认为1。
parameters.help_en: Page number of the annotate member list. The starting value is 1. The default value is 1
parameters.help_zh: 标注成员列表的页码。起始值为1，默认为1
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.description_en: The number of annotated members displayed per page in a paged query. Default value: 20.

parameters.help_en: The number of annotated members displayed per page in a paged query. Default value: 20
